your cleaning motivation to beat the overwhelm…does your house represent inside your head too?🤯
items.transcript: The state of my home represents inside my head, so if I'm busy then my house is a mess exactly like it is now. The cleaning has been somewhat neglected around here but rather than getting overwhelmed about how much there is to do, I've discovered that if I just focus on resetting one room rather than the whole house, it really helps to make me feel more calm. Highly recommend if you're feeling overwhelmed too, or if you're a fellow queen of procrastinating. It has felt very autumnal and cosy this week, hasn't it? I love the change in seasons because it always feels like a fresh start and a new beginning.

I need your inspiration!🏡✨ What colour do you think I should paint the kitchen cabinets?

We’ve been hosting our Airbnb for over 8 years and I think it’s finally time for a little glow up in here.

I’d love to give the kitchen in our holiday let a fresh new look, but I’m completely torn on the cabinet colour.

What colour would you choose? Let me know your ideas in the comments✨
items.transcript: Being an Airbnb host has humbled me in ways I wasn't prepared for, and it's changeover day today, so let's get cleaning. We've been hosting on Airbnb for eight years now, and there's never any judgment here. Trust me, I have seen it all, and it's a good job I enjoy cleaning. Our Airbnb is in what used to be the stables, and it's got its own private garden. We actually moved in here when we were renovating our main house, so it's got a bit of a special place in our hearts. But I've decided it's time to give the Airbnb a little glow up, and I need your help. I'm thinking of painting these kitchen cabinets, which Gavin says will not be possible, but I am determined. I'm just not sure what colour to go for. I made a right old mess tying this viral plug hole on blocker, so won't be buying that again. I can report that no knickers were left down the back of the sofa this time, and again, no judgment from me. When you stay in an Airbnb, please never feel pressured to clean before you leave. Honestly, we do not expect it. You're on holiday. The main thing is take the bins out and take any unwanted food. I'm sorry, but no one's going to be tucking into your half-eaten box of brown flakes. All that's left is to water me hanging baskets, and we're ready for guests.

items.caption:
Men I may not know, but cleaning products… cleaning products I know🤭✨

I have tried and tested so many cleaning products over the years so here are some of my favourites🧼🫧

Did I miss any? Let me know yours🥰
items.transcript: There are so many cleaning products so it can be overwhelming to know what to buy, so I thought I'd show you ten of my favourites that you'll always find in my cleaning cupboard. Unmatched for cleaning your kitchen surfaces, this is such a versatile product because it's also amazing for mirrors and glass and honestly a few spritzes of this and your whole room will smell divine. If you've got pets or kids for that matter then this is a must-have. I always have this in the cupboard, we get through so much of this with the dogs. I use it on the carpets, rugs, it's also really good on the sofa as well or the mattress. If you live in a hard water area and you get limescale on everything then you need Viacal, nothing and I mean nothing beats this and this smells amazing. I use it on the bathrooms but also on my kitchen sink. If your washing machine's smelling a bit musty and she's in need of a spa day, treat her to some Venousia. This new floral dream scent smells so good. This is my favourite floor cleaner, it's from Mrs Hinch's Midsummer Memories range. It's so easy to use, you don't have to faff around, you literally squirt and mop and it smells divine. My all-time favourite Zaflora scent, Lyn and Fresh. I know this sounds silly but to me this just smells so clean. You'll probably see I use this all the time in my videos, Fairy Skip the Soap. This is amazing for getting rid of grease and grime in the oven and off of pots and pans. Buster Plug Hole Unblocker, this is the one for the bathroom but the one for the kitchen is also great as well. Pink Stuff Foam in Toilet Cleaner is so satisfying to use for a deep clean. Squat Mummy Sponges, these are definitely worth the money, they last for ages and I chop mine in the washing machine.
